title: My journey of designing a card game from scratch with AI (unity)
author: Chocoweb88
selftext:
Hi everyone, recently I am learning how to edit video with capcut, so I want to share my journey of my self taught (well, Ai-taught) card game design.

My workplace allows me to gain knowledge in Google Play Console and mobile game design flow. And since I learn about how AI is capable of helping one learn to code, create games, and design assets, I dived into the vibecoding rabbit hole and stucked in it for 8 months and im loving the sleepless nights since then.

This game concept starts simple, a fast pace card game where you must read your opponent and choose your card in 5 seconds, and the theme is swords, duel, and swordmanship spirit. After test play my first prototype, I keep getting more and more ideas and want to add more content in the game (help)

The first iteration is just a simple tap tap simulator. No bg, very basic tap interaction.

2nd iteration starts to populate the UI UX, I mainly check how other mobile game is doing, and copy their uiux display and try to make it work.

3rd iteration I finally implement drag and play and also enhance it to 60fps. It feels amazing as I test play it on my own device, but Im getting feedback that the gameplay is still stale, and not very engaging.

Last and lateat iteration I try to incorporate slash-to-play in the card game. Instead of just drag the card to play field, you use it to "slash" and plays it out.  There will also be "quick time event " where you execute the slash in correct way to gain a power up.

Look back at my own game design journey , Im quite happy with how far I gone, and decide to share it here. The game still has many room of improvement mainly in the uiux and animation aspect, I hope to share the final product one day that can be a decent fun time for everyone to enjoy. Cheers!
